package sample

// Client talks to a Server.
type Client struct {
	srv *Server
}

// Dial connects to srv.
func Dial(srv *Server) *Client {
	srv.reset()
	return &Client{srv: srv}
}

// Addr returns the server address.
func (c *Client) Addr() string {
	return c.srv.Addr
}

func init() {
	_ = DefaultAddr
	_ = version
}
